supporting_quotes.exact: In a circularly linked list, all nodes are linked in a continuous circle, without using null. For lists with a front and a back (such as a queue), one stores a reference to the last node in the list. The next node after the last node is the first node. Elements can be added to the back of the list and removed from the front in constant time.
Circularly linked lists can be either singly or doubly linked.

observations.subject: circularly linked list (Wikipedia)
observations.object: all nodes linked in a continuous circle without null; single reference to the last node for front-and-back lists; next node after the last is the first; constant-time add-to-back and remove-from-front

claims.rationale: 引文1 [0,343) 逐句对应 claim 的“连成连续环、不使用 null、有头有尾列表只需存尾节点引用、尾节点之后即首节点、尾部加入与头部移除为常数时间”；引文2 [0,62) 支持“可用单链或双链实现”。claim 明确以“在 Wikipedia 的表述中”限定来源，与引文来源一致，全部对应。

supporting_quotes.exact: With a circular list, a pointer to the last node gives easy access also to the first node, by following one link. Thus, in applications that require access to both ends of the list (e.g., in the implementation of a queue), a circular structure allows one to handle the structure by a single pointer, instead of two.

A circularly linked list may be a natural option to represent arrays that are naturally circular, e.g. the corners of a polygon, a pool of buffers that are used and released in FIFO (first in, first out) order, or a set of processes that should be time-shared in round-robin order.

observations.subject: circular list
observations.object: access to the first node via one link from the last node, so both-end access (e.g., queue implementation) is handled by a single pointer instead of two

observations.subject: circularly linked list
observations.object: naturally circular data: polygon corners, FIFO buffer pools, and round-robin time-shared process sets

claims.rationale: 引文1 [0,112) 支持“指向尾节点的指针沿一条链接即可访问首节点”，[224,315) 支持“需访问两端的应用（如队列实现）只需一个指针而非两个”；引文2 [0,282) 支持“天然循环数据：多边形顶点、FIFO 使用与释放的缓冲池、按 round-robin 分时的进程组”。claim 的三个子句与两条引文逐一对应，无超引力内容。
